title: WhatsApp Business API (Cloud API)
seoTitle: What Is the WhatsApp Business API? Explained Simply
seoDescription: The WhatsApp Business Platform lets software send and receive WhatsApp messages at scale. Templates, pricing, the 24-hour window, consent and uses.
summary: The WhatsApp Business API, now the WhatsApp Business Platform with Meta's Cloud API, lets your software send and receive WhatsApp messages automatically: order updates, reminders, OTPs and support chats, from a business number that many staff and systems can share.

dataPoints.label: Replying
dataPoints.value: Free-form replies allowed within 24 hours of the customer's last message

dataPoints.label: Pricing
dataPoints.value: Charged per template message, varying by category (marketing, utility, authentication)

dataPoints.label: Consent
dataPoints.value: Customers must opt in; opt-outs must be respected

body:
## App, Business app, or Platform

The regular WhatsApp Business app suits one person on one phone. The Platform suits businesses that need automation, integrations with CRM or ERP, multiple agents and volume.

## Common uses

- Order and delivery updates, COD confirmation.
- Appointment and payment reminders.
- Support chats logged in a CRM.

See [WhatsApp Business API: automating customer communication](/blog/whatsapp-business-api-automating-customer-communication).

faqs.a: Not necessarily; the Cloud API is available directly from Meta. Providers add inboxes, templates and integrations for a fee.

faqs.q: Can I send bulk promotional messages?
faqs.a: Only as approved marketing templates to customers who opted in, and quality ratings can limit sending if many users block or report you.
